ov: Ocean mammals that breathe air and feed their young on milk, including the blue whale, the largest animal that has ever lived. Their closest living relatives are hippos.

why.d: Every whale eats animals. Baleen whales filter out krill and plankton; toothed whales hunt fish and squid.
why.et: Arctic Indigenous peoples have traditionally eaten whale meat and blubber.

rg: Every ocean, from polar seas to the tropics.
